title: Design System: Wheeler Cat — Variant H (audience-routing reframe: renters-first)

variant.bet: pick the rental audience over the multi-audience compression; RENT NOW becomes the hero verb; rental fleet foregrounded; finance demoted to a secondary band; sales-quote retained smaller; service-call stays accessible
variant.capturedTraitAmplified: rental audience (currently one of 6+ buyer paths above the fold, demoted under the finance promo carousel)
variant.evidence: voice.navItems contains 'RENT NOW' as a primary nav verb; voice.ctaSamples includes 'RENT NOW'; captured tagline mentions 'Construction Equipment, Tool & Trailer Rental & Sales' (rental named first); pages/home.json shows >4 distinct CTA verbs above the fold (audience-routing reframe trigger)
variant.iaFidelity: reimagined (H is the ONLY variant that reimagines IA — all other variants are verbatim)

differentiationFrom.A: A preserves IA verbatim (finance → service → support → locations); H reframes IA (rental-hero → rental-fleet-grid → finance band demoted → service → locations). 4 diffs: hero verb (BROWSE MORE SERVICES vs RENT NOW), second-band content (finance cards vs rental-fleet category grid), finance position (above-fold in A vs below-fold in H), CTA hierarchy (multi-verb in A vs renters-led in H).
differentiationFrom.iaPriorityShift: H demotes finance and sales-quote but DOES NOT remove them. Service-call path stays first-viewport accessible (24/7 phone strip retained in header). Audience compression is untangled, not destroyed. Other audiences (contractors, fleet operators) can still reach finance / sales / service in ≤ 2 clicks.

iaReframe.rationale: H's bet — pick renter audience over multi-audience compression. The rental fleet (tools, trailers, compact track loaders, light-tower kits) is named first in Wheeler's own tagline but never leads the page.
iaReframe.audienceLed: renters (operators needing equipment for 1-day to 6-month rental terms, plus contractors with short-term peak-demand gaps)

demotedAudiences.name: finance-led buyers
demotedAudiences.preservedBy: header CTA NEW QUOTE still visible; finance offers band still above scroll-2 fold

demotedAudiences.name: sales-quote buyers
demotedAudiences.preservedBy: NEW QUOTE link retained in main nav

demotedAudiences.name: service-callers
demotedAudiences.demotedTo: header phone strip + footer service link
demotedAudiences.preservedBy: 24/7 phone number stays in dark utility bar

iaPrioritiesOverride.rationale: H's IA reframe legitimately moves the multi-audience-compression priority. Mode A's IA-priority preservation audit fires on the renter-foreground / finance-demote shift; H records the override per intent-dimensions.md § 8 'movable mutability' under reimagined.
iaPrioritiesOverride.preservationFloor: all 6 captured audience verbs (BROWSE, NEW QUOTE, SHOP USED, RENT NOW, REQUEST SERVICE, CREDIT APP) remain reachable from the home page in ≤ 1 click from first viewport. Demoted audiences are reframed, not removed.

header.treatment: captured chrome retained; RENT NOW link upweighted (Roboto Condensed 700 yellow ground); other nav links neutral
header.phoneStrip: service-call CTA retained for service-caller accessibility

hero.headline: RENT THE GEAR YOU NEED, TODAY (direction-authorized rewrite — captured surface has 'RENT NOW' CTA but no captured headline for a rental-led hero; classify as direction-authorized in provenance)
hero.supportingLine: Construction equipment, tools, and trailers across 18 branches — book online or call your nearest yard. (synthesized from captured tagline; classify as direction-authorized)
hero.primaryCTA: BROWSE RENTAL FLEET (direction-authorized — captured has 'BROWSE MORE SERVICES' as model)
hero.ground: captured Wheeler_Campus photo OR equipment portrait — pick one

rentalFleetBand.layout: 4-up category grid: COMPACT TRACK LOADERS · EXCAVATORS · LIGHT TOWERS · ATTACHMENTS (categories sourced from captured icomoon classes + captured 'Compact Track Loader' photo + captured industry vocabulary)
rentalFleetBand.treatment: icomoon glyph + category label + 'X UNITS · Y BRANCHES' availability framing (UNITS / BRANCHES counts are NOT captured — render as PLACEHOLDER · availability-count)
rentalFleetBand.rationale: Renters' first question is 'what's available and where' — this band answers both without inventing inventory numbers

financeBand.headline: Finance options when you're ready to own (direction-authorized — softer framing than captured 'FINANCING DEALS & SPECIAL OFFERS')

serviceTiles.position: fourth band (unchanged from captured order, just preceded by rental)

locationsProof.treatment: Improvement #4 inherited (narrative proofs replace floating numerals); BRANCH FINDER widget upweighted because renters need 'closest yard' as primary

antiToolboxAudit.rationale: Single bet (IA reframe to rental audience). No invented colors, no invented fonts. Rental-fleet category grid uses captured icomoon glyphs + captured equipment photography. The few direction-authorized copy rewrites (hero headline, supporting line) are documented in voice classification per Discipline 5. PLACEHOLDER signature used for unavailable inventory counts.

extensions.unsourcedContentInheritance: 5 partner logos (inherited from variants A/B/C); PLUS rental-fleet availability counts (X UNITS · Y BRANCHES per category) — direction-authorized addition. The fleet category grid is renderable without these counts (just category label + glyph + CTA), but the availability framing is what makes H's bet land. Renders with PLACEHOLDER · availability-count signatures and shape hints (e.g. 'e.g. 42 UNITS · 11 BRANCHES'); migrate guard catches before any production deploy.
